capGpxName: GPX Track Matching & GPS Tagging (GPX Matching)

optSidecarOnlyDesc: Only write metadata to {file}.xmp sidecars without modifying original photos (equivalent to sidecar_policy=sidecar_only)
optCompanionExtsDesc: Associated companion file extensions (e.g. wav, acr, exf) to discover and move atomically
optRawExtsDesc: Recognized RAW photo extensions used as primary decision assets (comma separated)
optWorkersDesc: Number of concurrent worker goroutines processing photo assets (Default NumCPU)
optAllowNoGpsDesc: Benignly skip geocoding for photos without GPS coordinates, continuing safely to date archiving
optTestBackupDesc: Automatically backup source photos to Inbox_bak before executing pipeline
optLanguageDesc: Interface, CLI help and Shell Tab completion language (zh-CN / en-US)
optGeosyncDesc: Camera clock & GPS track synchronization offset (e.g. 0, +15, -00:01:30)
optWindowDesc: Maximum allowed time window for spherical time-weighted GPS interpolation (e.g. 15m, 30m, 1h)
optGeocodeLangDesc: Language format for reverse geocoded IPTC/XMP location tags (Default zh-CN)
optInPlaceDesc: Standardize filenames in-place within source directory without creating Processed/YYYY/MMDD/
